para.string: Clears the DF flag in the EFLAGS register. When the DF flag is set to 0, string operations increment the index regis­ters (ESI and/or EDI). Operation is the same in all modes.
The DF flag is set to 0. The CF, OF, ZF, SF, AF, and PF flags are unaffected.
